messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about International politics and organisations in Berlin, Baden-Württemberg, Bavaria, Bremen, Hesse, Hamburg, Lower Saxony, North Rhine-Westphalia, Rhineland-Palatinate, Saarland, and Schleswig-Holstein during the 1990s?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: GESIS German federal states election results 1990 1999 dataset Landtagswahlen
German Länder international relations 1990s dataset regional international organisations
Manifesto Project dataset German state elections 1990s regional
German federal states 1990s foreign population migration regional database GENESIS
action.query: GESIS German federal states election results 1990 1999 dataset Landtagswahlen

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"GESIS – State Parliament Election Studies (Landtagswahlen), Germany","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/wahlen/landtagswahlen","justification":"A collection of historical election datasets covering German federal states, including Berlin, Baden-Württemberg, Bavaria, Bremen, Hesse, Hamburg, Lower Saxony, North Rhine-Westphalia, Rhineland-Palatinate, Saarland, and Schleswig-Holstein. Includes election studies from the 1990s, providing information on political attitudes, party preferences, voting behavior, and political institutions. Relevant for investigating regional political developments and attitudes toward international politics during the decade."},{"title":"Konrad Adenauer Foundation – Historical German Federal, European, and State Election Results Since 1946","url_or_doi":"https://www.kas.de/en/web/wahlanalysen-und-gesellschaftsstudien/election-results-representative-election-statistics","justification":"Provides historical election results for Germany and its federal states, including the eleven requested regions. Covers the 1990s and includes European Parliament, Bundestag, and state parliamentary elections. Particularly valuable for studying political parties, European integration, international political representation, and regional differences in electoral support for internationally oriented parties."},{"title":"GERDA – German Election Database","url_or_doi":"https://www.german-elections.com/election-data/","justification":"A comprehensive database containing harmonized German municipal, state, and federal election results beginning in the 1990s. Provides geographically detailed election statistics that can be analyzed across the requested federal states. Useful for examining regional variations in political representation, international political issues, European integration, and the electoral consequences of German reunification."},{"title":"GERDA: The German Election Database – Scientific Data","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-025-04811-5","justification":"A peer-reviewed description of a harmonized dataset covering German elections at municipal, state, and federal levels since the 1990s. Supports geographically detailed comparative research across German federal states. Particularly relevant for studying political organizations, electoral competition, and regional responses to European and international political developments. The DOI leads to the publication describing the dataset and its availability."},{"title":"Manifesto Project Database – Political Party Policy Preferences","url_or_doi":"https://manifesto-project.wzb.eu/datasets/","justification":"An internationally comparative dataset of political party election manifestos, including German political parties active during the 1990s. Contains coded information about foreign policy, international cooperation, European integration, national sovereignty, and political institutions. Useful for analyzing the international policy positions of parties represented in the requested German states. Geographic coverage is primarily national rather than state-specific."},{"title":"GESIS – Research Data Center for Elections","url_or_doi":"https://www.konsortswd.de/angebote/forschende/alle-datenzentren/fdz-wahlen/","justification":"Provides access information for archived German electoral research datasets, including federal elections, state elections, and historical political opinion surveys. Its collections include election studies and political surveys conducted during the 1990s. Relevant for examining attitudes toward international organizations, European integration, German reunification, and foreign policy across the requested states. This is a research data center landing page rather than an individual dataset."},{"title":"Federal Statistical Office of Germany – Migration Between Federal States by Nationality, Gender, Origin, and Destination","url_or_doi":"https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets/30303031-3237-4031-312d-303032320000","justification":"An official statistical dataset covering migration between German federal states, classified by nationality, gender, state of origin, and destination. Includes the geographic categories needed to investigate population movements across the requested regions. Potentially useful for analyzing international migration and its relationship to regional political developments and integration policies. Availability of observations specifically from 1990–1999 should be verified before use."},{"title":"German Local Manifesto Project – Local Political Party Manifestos","url_or_doi":"https://localmanifestoproject.de/","justification":"Provides a research infrastructure for analyzing political party manifestos and political competition at the local level in Germany. The dataset includes geographic identifiers, political organizations, and election years, supporting comparisons between municipalities and federal states. Potentially relevant for examining local political positions toward international cooperation, European integration, and migration. Coverage of the 1990s is not established, so this is a supplementary source rather than a confirmed historical match."},{"title":"WZB Berlin Social Science Center – Political Science Databases","url_or_doi":"https://www.wzb.eu/en/publications/databases","justification":"A research database directory maintained by the Berlin Social Science Center, featuring political science datasets concerning democracy, political parties, political representation, and international comparative politics. Includes resources with historical coverage extending into the 1990s, such as the Manifesto Project and Democracy Barometer. Useful for identifying additional datasets about international politics and political organizations, although most resources are not disaggregated by German federal state."},{"title":"German Election Database – Historical State and Federal Political Representation","url_or_doi":"https://www.kas.de/de/web/wahlanalysen-und-gesellschaftsstudien/wahlergebnisse-und-repraesentative-wahlstatistiken","justification":"The German-language landing page for the Konrad Adenauer Foundation's historical election data. Provides state-specific electoral results extending back before the 1990s, including European Parliament elections. Offers a consistent historical basis for comparing electoral support for political organizations across Berlin, Baden-Württemberg, Bavaria, Bremen, Hesse, Hamburg, Lower Saxony, North Rhine-Westphalia, Rhineland-Palatinate, Saarland, and Schleswig-Holstein. Particularly suitable for studying the regional political context of European integration in the 1990s."}]}
